🚀

Our mission

Local-first · No account required

AstraFocus Nexus turns a simple checklist into a supportive coach: it helps you choose what matters, work in focused bursts, and stay kind to yourself. Your tasks and preferences stay in your browser—nothing is uploaded to our servers.

⚡

What you can do here

  • 🧠

    Wellness check-ins

    Mood and stress, with suggestions tied to your task list.

  • ⏱️

    Pomodoro sessions

    Focus and breaks with optional sound, tab attention, and notifications.

  • 🧭

    Eisenhower matrix

    See urgent vs important work at a glance and move tasks between quadrants.

  • 🎯

    Goals & progress

    Link tasks to outcomes and track completion over time.

  • 🔔

    Due reminders

    Browser notifications when you allow them and set a due time.

💡

Why it helps

  • 🎯 Turns vague stress into one small, concrete next step.
  • ⚡ Protects attention with timed focus and gentle breaks.
  • 📈 Makes priorities visible so busywork doesn’t crowd out what matters.
💫

Quick tips

  • Press Enter in the task field on Home to add a task quickly.
  • Set priority with the tiles on Home—codes UI, UN, NI,{" "} NN match the matrix.
  • On Wellness, use Break down 3 steps when you feel stuck—it reads your open tasks.
🔒

Privacy & technical details

Everything runs in your browser. Expand a topic below for storage keys and notification tips.

Privacy & local storage

Your data is stored in localStorage on this device only:

  • task-tracker.tasks.v4 — tasks
  • pomodoro.settings — timer lengths and options
  • pomodoro.session.v1 — active session (mode, end time, pause state)
  • task-tracker.goals.v1 — goals
  • wellness.entry.YYYY-MM-DD — daily mood and stress

Clearing site data, using private browsing, or switching browsers/devices will not carry your list over. There is no cloud sync or sign-in in this version.

Notifications
  • Use the bell in the nav or the alerts control on the Focus page to request permission when your browser asks.
  • Notifications require a secure context (HTTPS or localhost).
  • If nothing appears, open site settings for this page and set Notifications to Allow.
Coming soon
🛤️

Roadmap ideas

Not promised timelines—just directions we’re considering.

  • Location-aware reminders e.g. nudges when you’re near a store
  • Focus mode surface only today’s top few tasks
  • Templates student, job search, health, and similar presets
  • Light gamification streaks or badges, kept optional
  • Optional email summaries if you explicitly opt in later
